name: Coded Singletons
definition: For $n\ge1$, take primary coordinates $p_1,\ldots,p_n$ and $r=\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil$ tag coordinates. Assign distinct $r$-bit strings $c_0,c_1,\ldots,c_n$ to the $n+1$ indices. The class has $n+1$ concepts $h_0,\ldots,h_n$: $h_i$ is positive precisely on $p_i$ when $i\ne0$ and has tag labels $c_i$.
